title: Work IQ: long-running tasks for A2A and MCP agents
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, billing statements and documented controls match the sources checked. It distinguishes existing Work IQ controls from the planned task capability and leaves task-specific defaults, retention and administration unanswered rather than inventing them.
